text:
maria: Quick note: onboarding run for `rerank-mini-ptq` on holdout-F shows a small but consistent NDCG@10 regression vs fp16; digging in.

cheng: Numbers?

maria: fp16 NDCG@10=0.462, ptq mean=0.445 across 4 seeds. MRR drops ~0.013. Stddev across seeds for ptq 0.009 vs fp16 0.002.

devin: Do we see retrieval nondet or scoring noise?

maria: Ran two controlled jobs: (A) snapshot topk + ptq scoring -> stdev 0.003; (B) live retrieval + force-kernel-determinism -> stdev 0.008. So retrieval nondet is main driver, but ptq increases sensitivity to small retrieval diffs.

qa-bot: Snapshot created s3://redwood-eval/holdoutF/snap-1865432100. Fingerprint tool available: `eval-hash-topk --run-id 1865432100`

cheng: Can we add per-query topk fingerprints (sha1 concat id:score) and a Jaccard summary in the harness? That will make triage easier and work with CI alerts.

maria: Will do. Also noticed tokenizer parity issue for a small fraction (~2%) of queries: eval harness used `tokenize_v2` while prod uses `tokenize_v3` which changes truncation. That amplified candidate differences for short queries.

devin: Plan:
1) Patch harness to default to prod tokenizer for onboarding runs and emit topk fingerprints.
2) Run 6-seed fingerprint sweep with snapshot retrieval and collect per-query score stdev + logits (float16) for top 200 high-variance queries.
3) If fingerprint Jaccard < 0.86 across seeds, mark as retrieval instability and engage infra; otherwise run layer-ablations (early/mid/tail int8) to find scoring-sensitive partitions.

ops-bot: Alert rule suggestion: `rerank-onboard-topk-drift` -> trigger when relative NDCG drop > 1.8% AND mean topk Jaccard < 0.87 across two sequential runs. Include s3 artifact link in alert.

maria: I'll upload artifacts and open a small PR for the harness changes. Tagging @cheng @devin for review.

cheng: Thanks — once artifacts are up Ill run an infra-level check on ANN merge ordering.
